advisor.source: live Supabase security advisor plus read-only catalog verification

classes.name: rls_enabled_no_policy
classes.evidence: RLS is enabled and no client policy exists; this is fail-closed. Eight affected tables are private and four public tables require intended service-role-only verification.

classes.name: extension_in_public
classes.evidence: pg_net 0.20.4 is installed in public and extrelocatable=false. A simple ALTER EXTENSION SET SCHEMA is not safe.
classes.nextGate: Map dependencies and prepare a tested rollback-aware relocation/reinstall design in isolation.

exactEvidence.shared: All 11 functions are owned by postgres, SECURITY DEFINER, executable by authenticated/postgres/service_role, and not executable by anon or PUBLIC.
exactEvidence.decideApproval: Direct authenticated RPC permits owner/admin/operator and still requires AAL2. This bypasses the locked owner/admin approval contract. The reviewed AAL1 owner/admin-only replacement is source-tested but not deployed.
exactEvidence.projectosGetRegistry: Returns projectos_project_resources.configuration verbatim to any permanent organization member; arbitrary JSON is not proven secret-free, and the table read policy exposes the same row.
exactEvidence.remainingFunctions: projectos_get_registry is both a release blocker and one of nine broad-search-path functions. The other eight broad-search-path functions require hardening before release; immediate object-shadowing is mitigated because anon/authenticated have no CREATE privilege in searched schemas. create_organization uses an empty search_path and its caller/authorization checks are acceptable.

classes.name: auth_allow_anonymous_sign_ins
classes.evidence: Twenty-seven policies delegate to permanent-account helpers that require auth.uid(), reject is_anonymous=true, and require active membership; profiles is self-row only; two cron policies bind CURRENT_USER. Current anonymous-user count is zero. No broad policy rewrite is justified.

classes.name: auth_leaked_password_protection
classes.evidence: The advisor reports protection disabled; the project has three password hashes and three email identities, so the finding affects an active authentication path.

sourceOnlyRemediationState.migrationHistory: 50 live identities documented; 48 exact live-recorded SQL payloads recovered; one additional executable foundation candidate was recovered from immutable canonical Git evidence but exact live equivalence remains unverified; the other foundation remains missing
